description: The original R1-R6 inputs from the approved coach-agent specification. Only subsequent user replies and the R4 host click are simulated; all assistant responses and tool execution come from the real SDK/model path.

messages: 坐了挺久 我想拉伸一下
你帮我安排一个计划吧
cases.simulatedClarificationReply: 我在办公室，只有椅子和墙，想放松肩颈和髋部，大约10分钟。目前没有伤病、疼痛或其他运动限制。
review: Later planning uses the earlier sitting/stretching context.
Already supplied office, equipment, duration and safety facts are not asked again.

messages: 我想针对大腿内侧进行拉伸
cases.simulatedClarificationReply: 在家，有瑜伽垫，想拉伸大腿内侧，10分钟。目前没有伤病、疼痛或其他运动限制。
review: The returned catalog actions actually target the inner thigh.
No invented equipment or unsupported actions.

messages: 在家徒手 20 分钟练核心
cases.simulatedClarificationReply: 初学者，在家徒手，没有垫子或其他器材，20分钟练核心。目前没有伤病、疼痛或其他运动限制。
review: Core focus is reflected in the performed actions.
Known home/bodyweight/20-minute facts are not asked again.

messages: 推荐几个练肩的哑铃动作
cases.simulatedClarificationReply: 在家，有一对哑铃，初学者，主要练肩，可以安排10分钟。目前没有伤病、疼痛或其他运动限制。

hostAction.label: 排成计划
hostAction.message: 把刚才推荐的动作排成计划

review: The host action sends an ordinary user message on the same real controller.
The model requests reuse; prior node results are reused without a seeded task or fabricated check.
Shoulder focus and available dumbbells survive promotion.

cases.simulatedClarificationReply: 只是偶尔有响声，没有疼痛、肿胀、卡住或受伤，也没有其他运动限制。
review: An in-scope health/exercise question is answered without forced task nodes or a training plan.
The answer distinguishes painless sounds from symptoms that warrant stopping and assessment.

messages: I sit all day, help me stretch
cases.simulatedClarificationReply: I am in an office with a chair and wall. I want to stretch my shoulders, neck and hips for about ten minutes. I have no pain, injuries or other exercise restrictions.
review: English intent and parameters map to the same catalog encodings.
The assistant does not invent restrictions or repeat known facts.
